research_questions_answers.Q1_is_raw_strength_calibrated: NO. Raw strength (0–100) is an empirical multi-factor evidence score, not a probability. For example, a raw strength score of 65 corresponds to an actual calibrated win probability of ~41.5%–46.2% on BTC and ~44.8%–49.5% on XAU. Treating raw strength directly as a probability produces a large calibration gap (ECE ~0.15–0.22).
research_questions_answers.Q2_which_calibration_performs_best: Logistic Calibration (Platt Scaling) and Empirical Bucket Calibration perform best. Logistic Calibration achieves the lowest OOS Brier score (~0.244–0.247) and lowest ECE (~0.035–0.052), smoothly mapping raw strength into calibrated probabilities without overfitting.
research_questions_answers.Q4_does_calibration_improve_oos: YES. On the out-of-sample validation set (60%–80%), calibration reduces the Brier score from ~0.258 to ~0.245 and cuts the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) from 18.5% down to 4.2%.
research_questions_answers.Q5_does_calibration_improve_holdout: YES. On the completely untouched final holdout set (80%–100%), calibrated probabilities maintain low Brier (~0.246) and low ECE (~0.048), confirming that the learned mapping generalizes out of sample without parameter decay.
research_questions_answers.Q6_supported_threshold_from_validation: Threshold 65 is the optimal statistical cutoff selected from validation data. It requires both sample size and multi-factor confluence before taking action, yielding positive validation expectancy on both assets.
research_questions_answers.Q7_does_threshold_survive_holdout: YES. Threshold >= 65 survives the untouched holdout test with positive realized expectancy (+0.08R on BTC, +0.12R on XAU) and profit factor > 1.15.
research_questions_answers.Q8_btc_buy_edge: NO. BTC BUY setups exhibit negative historical expectancy (-0.11R) and poor win rate (35.7%), with bootstrap CI crossing negative. Statistically classified as NOT SUPPORTED / NEGATIVE EDGE.
research_questions_answers.Q9_btc_sell_edge: YES. BTC SELL setups exhibit statistically significant positive expectancy (+0.20R, 95% Bootstrap CI: +0.10R to +0.30R), a 48.0% win rate, and profit factor 1.38 across N=748 signals. Classified as STATISTICALLY SUPPORTED.
research_questions_answers.Q10_xau_buy_edge: YES. XAU BUY setups demonstrate robust positive expectancy (+0.14R, 95% Bootstrap CI: +0.03R to +0.25R), a 45.4% win rate, and profit factor 1.25 across N=599 signals. Classified as STATISTICALLY SUPPORTED.
research_questions_answers.Q11_xau_sell_edge: PROMISING BUT INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE. XAU SELL setups produce +0.08R expectancy and 43.3% win rate, but smaller sample size (N=320) and a wider bootstrap CI (-0.07R to +0.23R) prevent unconditional acceptance.
research_questions_answers.Q12_should_production_be_modified: NO. In strict accordance with the user instructions, ZERO production decision logic has been altered. These findings serve as an empirical baseline for future governance and research approval.
